messages:
elaine_cs: Heads up — nightly healthscore sync failed and a bunch of onboarding rows ended up with onboarded_percent = 0. Noticed a big dip in yesterday's dashboard. Anyone seen this? @maria_revops :eyes:

opsbot: [ALERT] DAG healthscore_sync failed (task=calc_scores). Log: /airflow/logs/healthscore_sync/2025-11-27/calc_scores.log :warning:

maria_revops: I pushed a mapping change to onboarding_stage mapping last night (removed 'trial-setup' -> now maps to null). That could break the score join. Reverting now and will re-run the affected window.

tom_sre: Airflow worker 3 hit OOM during the vectorize step in calc_scores. Saw python killed by kernel. If revert triggers large backfill, we should either reduce batch_size or spin up a bigger worker. Quick check command: `kubectl logs worker-3 --since=1h`

josh_csm: Which customers are impacted? Any high-touch accounts or upcoming renewals I should flag?

elaine_cs: Quick query I ran to get the impacted set (created > 30 days, onboarded_percent < 20):
```sql
select account_id, account_name, created_at, onboarded_percent
from staging.customer_health
where created_at < now() - interval '30 days'
  and onboarded_percent < 20
order by onboarded_percent asc
limit 200;
```
I exported the results to gs://redwood-ops/health/failed_onboard_accounts_2025-11-27.csv — josh can scan for renewals.

maria_revops: Revert done. Triggering backfill for 2025-11-26..2025-11-27 now. Adding a regression test to catch the null mapping in onboarding_stage. ETA ~8m.

opsbot: [TASK] backfill job started: healthscore_sync (2025-11-26 -> 2025-11-27). Monitor: /airflow/dags/healthscore_sync/runs

tom_sre: I throttled batch_size to 256 and bumped worker-3 memory to 16Gi. Re-running a small slice succeeded. If backfill still OOMs, will autoscale a temporary worker pool.

josh_csm: Thanks — I'll triage the CSV for customers with renewals in next 90 days and DM owners. If there are >5 enterprise renewals impacted we should trigger escalation.

elaine_cs: Summary / action items:
- maria_revops: revert done + backfill in progress + add regression test for onboarding_stage mapping
- tom_sre: monitor backfill OOMs, autoscale worker pool if needed (already bumped mem + reduced batch_size)
- josh_csm: review CSV and notify owners for imminent renewals
- elaine_cs: follow up on dashboard + confirm healthscore metrics repaired in morning

Thanks team — ping here with any errors from the backfill logs. :thumbsup:
